title: 高级听力三：野外研究、空间与报道
instruction: 听三段不同的录音，每段对应两题。各段录音内已播放两遍。从每题三个选项中选择最佳答案。

clips.context: You hear two researchers discussing equipment for a field project.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The smaller recorder would be easier to carry, but I'm not ready to order it. The supplier's demonstration was in a quiet room. Our recordings will be made beside working boats.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: They sent a graph showing how it performs with background noise.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Yes, though that tells us about the conditions they selected. I want to know whether we can still distinguish the calls we're studying when an engine starts halfway through one.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The larger model has a stronger reputation. Shall we choose that and avoid the risk?

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Reputation doesn't answer the question either. If it filters out the sound we're interested in along with the engine, a cleaner recording could actually be less useful.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Then we should borrow both for an afternoon at the harbour, using the same settings and position.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Exactly. I'm not trying to buy the most expensive device or the one with the most impressive graph. I want a comparison tied to the recording decision we'll have to make.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll ask for a loan. Better to find the awkward case now than after we've spent a week collecting material we can't use.

questions.stem: Why is the woman reluctant to order the smaller recorder?
options: A
Its weight would make fieldwork impractical.
B
Its performance in relevant conditions is uncertain.
C
The supplier has refused to provide any specifications.
questions.rationale: 展示安静、噪声图不说明研究船边特定声响能否区分，B。A反而更易携带；C已给图表，非拒绝一切规格。

questions.stem: What do the researchers agree to do?
options: A
Select the established model on reputation alone.
B
Postpone fieldwork until all noise can be eliminated.
C
Compare both devices in the intended setting.
questions.rationale: 借两机同位置同设置在港口测试，C。A被女人否定；B任务场景本有船，并未要消除所有噪声再研究。

clips.context: You hear an architect and a client discussing a meeting space.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Everyone liked the photographs of the finished room. Now that we're holding meetings in it, people at the back say they can't hear the discussion near the window.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: We tested a presentation with a single speaker, and that worked. We didn't test six people interrupting one another around a table. That's the use we need to look at now.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The manager wants a microphone for every seat. It sounds decisive, though I'm not sure anyone has asked how those meetings are actually run.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: More equipment might help, but it could also make the room harder to use. Before choosing a remedy, I'd sit through an ordinary meeting and note where people turn away, move their chairs, or try to speak at once.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You think we should change the way we work rather than the room?

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Not necessarily. We may need to change both. I'd just rather not treat a description of the problem as though it were already a diagnosis.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll arrange a visit during Tuesday's planning meeting. A room can look finished before we've understood how people are going to occupy it.

questions.stem: What limitation in the earlier test does the woman identify?
options: A
It covered a different pattern of communication.
B
It relied entirely on photographs of the room.
C
It involved more speakers than the room could hold.
questions.rationale: 此前只测单人presentation，实际为多人抢话讨论，A。B照片是外界评价非测试方法；C实际需求六人但未说人数超容量。

questions.stem: What does the woman want to avoid?
options: A
Allowing the client to observe a normal meeting.
B
Assuming a particular solution before examining the activity.
C
Considering changes to the room’s physical arrangement.
questions.rationale: 先看日常活动再诊断，不先把麦克风当定案，B。A正要求旁听；C明确可能两边都改，不排除物理布局。

clips.context: You hear two journalists discussing comments received after an article.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The readers' comments are more useful than I expected. One person spotted that we'd described the bus stop as being outside the station when it's across the square. We should correct that promptly.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Agreed. I'm less convinced by the demand that we remove the whole article because one interviewee disliked how her hesitation came across.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Neither am I, but I want to speak to her before we decide. She may be objecting to a detail we can check rather than asking us to make her sound more certain.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: So you wouldn't offer to rewrite her remarks immediately?

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: No. I'd ask which part she thinks fails to represent what she meant, then compare that with our recording. Listening seriously doesn't require promising the requested change in advance.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That's worth saying in our reply. Otherwise asking for clarification could sound like a polite way of refusing to act.

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Exactly. We should explain what we're checking and when we'll get back to her. It's possible to be open about the process without pretending we already know the outcome.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I'll draft that response, and fix the location error now. We needn't delay the straightforward correction while we consider the more complicated complaint.

questions.stem: How does the woman view the interviewee’s complaint?
options: A
It deserves clarification before its merits are decided.
B
It proves that the article must be withdrawn.
C
It should be ignored because hesitation was recorded.
questions.rationale: 她要先明确争议点再对录音，未先判正误，A。B不认同全撤；C即使有录音仍需听清何意，不是忽略。

questions.stem: What do the speakers agree about their response?
options: A
They should promise the wording will be changed.
B
They should postpone every correction until the complaint is settled.
C
They should explain the review while making the clear factual correction.
questions.rationale: 解释核查及回复时间，同时立改公交位置，C。A明确不预先承诺改字；B明确不拖延straightforward correction。
